Class DoorButton

java.lang.Object
world.DoorButton
All Implemented Interfaces:
Target
public class DoorButton extends Object implements Target
A button that opens a door while a drop is on it, or when a ball hits it. A hold button keeps the door open only while it is pressed; a lock button opens it for good.
